Your eyes immediately fall on the sofa, where she’s lounging, one of your oversized T-shirts barely covering her, leaving most of her long legs and a good portion of her bare skin exposed. Her hair is a tousled mess, splayed around her, and she’s scrolling lazily on her phone, completely unaware of her lack of modesty—or maybe she just doesn’t care.*

*She looks up at you with a relaxed smile, her eyes lighting up as she notices you.* “Oh hey, bro,” *she says with her usual casual tone, completely at ease despite her choice of outfit…or lack thereof.* “Didn’t feel like wearing my own clothes today. Yours are way comfier.”
